## L0 Core: the only place rules live
Every L workflow calls this with `{ action, data }`.

- `process` · validate, normalise, score
- `ai_adjust` · clamp AI to ±10, recompute tier
- `crm_upsert` · HubSpot upsert on unique `lead_key`
- `crm_update` · whitelisted fields only
- `log` · one row to a Sheet tab (RAW mode)

## crm_upsert
One HubSpot call per lead. Empty values are never sent, so a repeat can't blank existing data.
**New** contacts also get `engine_status=awaiting`, `followup_stage=0`, follow-up due in 24 h.

## crm_update
Used by L1/L2/L3. Only these fields may change: `engine_status`, `followup_stage`, `next_followup_at`, `first_reply_seconds`, `ai_summary`. Bad values throw an error (→ e0).

## log
Known columns only, max 500 chars each. RAW mode stores `=HYPERLINK(...)` as text, never as a formula.

## Rules (process + ai_adjust)
Pure code: no network, no AI.
Tiers: hot ≥ 70 · warm ≥ 40 · else cold.
AI text is parsed defensively; anything unreadable → adjust 0.
